title: Debian (APT) repository settings
description: The deb member of a repository document (R-REPO-004, R-DEB-008, R-DEB-024). A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable.

architectures.description: Architectures every suite's indexes are built for; a local repository adds the architectures of its stored files (R-DEB-008). 'all' is not listed: the files of that architecture are listed under every architecture of the suite.

compression.description: Index variants built besides gzip, which is always built (R-DEB-011).

origin.description: The Origin field of every Release (R-DEB-008).

label.description: The Label field of every Release; the repository key while the document does not set it (R-DEB-008).

suites.description: Suites a virtual repository serves besides those of its local members (R-DEB-008).

upstreamKeys.description: ASCII-armored OpenPGP public keys of the upstream (one block of 1 to 32 certificates, at most 256 KiB): a remote verifies the signatures of its upstream's release documents against them (R-DEB-020). Null leaves the remote unverified; a mirror and a member of a virtual repository need them.

mirror.description: What a mirror of an APT archive keeps (R-DEB-024, Q-DEB-17). Present in both modes of a remote repository and effective in mode mirror.

suites.description: Suites (below dists/) to mirror; required in mode mirror.

components.description: Components whose indexes and package files are kept.

architectures.description: Architectures whose Packages indexes and package files are kept; 'all' is always kept and not listed.

sources.description: Whether Sources indexes and source package files are kept.
